title: Fourier norm under a coordinate split
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $J$ be a subset of its coordinates. Sum the absolute values of the Fourier coefficients indexed by the union of a subset of $J$ and a subset of its complement, over all choices of both subsets. This sum equals the Fourier one-norm of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$J$ is a subset of the coordinate set
